note: The TAKEN status and Close this hunt act within the chosen candidate's own kind (S4b-BL-306, finding F1 of S4b-BL-216, docs/02 T-D15; docs/11 5.24). A candidate's kind is its `kind`; none is the house; any other id (a kind the build does not know) is a kind of its own. `choose`: the statuses, in order, of `houses` after candidate `id` is given `status`: choosing TAKEN returns the TAKEN candidate of the SAME kind to SHORTLISTED (at most one TAKEN per kind), another kind's TAKEN candidate is left as it is; any other status changes only that candidate; an id that is not listed changes nothing. `close`: the ids Close this hunt (and Mark them Not chosen) marks NOT_CHOSEN for TAKEN candidate `takenId`, in list order: the candidates of the same kind that are not the taken one and not already REJECTED or NOT_CHOSEN; an unlisted id closes nothing. The server has no such rule (the statuses are the person's, stored as sent). Readers: the website's house-status.spec.ts, :shared's HouseStatusRulesTest.

choose.name: the house path is today's: no kind on any candidate
a TAKEN school does not return the TAKEN house
a TAKEN house does not return the TAKEN school
a second school returns the first TAKEN school, the TAKEN house stays
a kind the build does not know is a kind of its own
another status changes only that candidate, whatever the kinds
an id that is not listed changes nothing

close.name: the house path is today's: every open house but the taken one
a taken school closes the open schools, never the houses
a taken house closes the open houses, never the schools
a taken school alone in its kind closes nothing
a kind the build does not know closes its own kind only
an id that is not listed closes nothing
